changes: Added runtime ICE settings and an additive relay-only field to the shared C++/Blueprint config.
Threaded copied ICE configuration through Direct client, Server and native owner-worker creation.
Added private C ABI configuration and redacted selected candidate diagnostics without changing existing event layouts.
Distinguished HTTP certificate/connection failures from timeout failures.
Added scoped local HTTPS and pinned-source coturn fixtures and packaged network acceptance tooling.
limitations: Physical iOS runtime acceptance remains deferred; iOS device archive was compiled/linked only.
Local HTTPS and TURN UDP/TCP only; no Internet NAT traversal, blocked UDP fallback, TURN/TLS, or hostile-network claim.
Packaged mobile reliability/drop, large-message/backpressure, reconnect, network loss and foreground/background acceptance remain open.
Development package sizes are not Shipping download sizes or an RTC size delta.
Native artifacts were built incrementally from pinned inputs; this change does not claim a fresh repeat-build comparison.
